svg.text: OBJ-192 Planter, long low trough on four casters
جاردينيرا طويلة منخفضة على أربع عجلات
SIZE 900 x 300 x 450 mm incl. casters (proposal)
REFERENCE PHOTO (not ours; low-resolution render, source unknown)
Shape estimated by eye from the
black and sage; the sage is not in the
objekt palette and is not used.
COLOURWAYS (Sabry, 12 Nov; names from the objekt colour guide)
Matte powder coat: Sabry. Powder maker matches HEX with a sample; confirm against a physical sample. Paint codes to follow.
Overall 900 x 300 x 450 mm incl. casters is a PROPOSAL (not costed, Production to confirm). Caster height 70 mm is assumed. المقاسات مقترحة، وارتفاع العجلة ٧٠ مم افتراضي.
Steel height 380 + casters 70 = 450. Panel top where the end-plate corner radius starts. ارتفاع الصاج ٣٨٠ + العجلات ٧٠ = ٤٥٠.
